biggest_catch: Adler Weiner's official FAQ confirms each project has a 'predetermined honorarium' but publishes no general numeric payout range, no session-duration band, and no payment deadline — every figure a friend would need is project-specific and undisclosed.
catches: No general numeric payout amount or range is published; each project's honorarium is disclosed only during that project's screening.
No official session-duration band and no official payment deadline.
Payment form varies by project (cash, checks, gift cards, prepaid debit cards, or products).
In-person projects require living within driving distance of a facility.

c1.evidence: Official FAQ confirms a paid participant program: 'Each project has a predetermined honorarium that may be received as cash, checks, gift cards, prepaid debit cards, or even products.' (adlerweiner.com/frequently-asked-questions)

c2.evidence: No general numeric payout range published — amounts are per-project and disclosed only during screening.

c3.evidence: No official payment deadline or payout-timing commitment published.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid, not charged.

eligibility: 13+ (under 18 needs a parent already in the database); in-person projects require living within driving distance of a facility; must qualify, participate as scheduled, and arrive on time
maximize: Only accept projects whose screener states an honorarium and session length you would accept — treat every Adler Weiner invitation as unknown pay until the recruiter confirms the amount, method, and timing in writing.
notes: Official FAQ and financial-incentives page (adlerweiner.com) fetched 2026-09-23. The honorarium exists but is project-specific; no general numeric payout, duration, or deadline is published.

s1.note: Honorarium confirmed but project-specific; no general numeric range.

s3.note: Eligibility stated officially: 13+, facility proximity, qualification per project.

s5.note: Flow documented: join panel, screen per project, participate, paid (amount/deadline per project).

s6.note: Honorarium disclosed per project during screening, not upfront publicly.

s7.note: Studies by invitation; no volume guaranteed.
